name: Feedback CLI verb family
purpose: Own the rcf feedback core verb and its sub-dispatcher (add, list, preview, submit, defer, discard, opt-in, opt-out, hook, status), exposing the surface the agent, the operator and the harness hooks all call.
responsibilities: Register feedback in bin/rcf.js CORE map alongside init, doctor, guidance, mcp, version
Parse and validate sub-verb flags and enums before touching store or network
Return the documented exit codes per sub-verb (0 success, 2 usage, 3 outcome with residual pending)
Export HELP text for the help-parity test and mirror the core verb help conventions
Route each sub-verb to store, redact, render, destination, gh, hook without any cross-module state
internalStructure: src/cli/feedback.js is a sub-dispatcher with a HELP export and one handler per sub-verb; each handler reads flags, calls into src/feedback/* pure modules, and prints the shaped result. Handlers never shell out directly; the gh call sits behind src/feedback/gh.js.

interfaces.name: feedbackMain
interfaces.description: Argv-driven main; matches the core-verb signature the top-level dispatcher expects.

interfaces.name: HELP
interfaces.description: Static help text asserted by the help-parity test.

dependencies.name: TAC-4108-feedback-hook
dependencies.description: Hook handler; called by hook sub-verb.

tradeoffs: A single core verb keeps the surface easy to reference in RULE 17 and in docs; the cost is a moderately sized sub-dispatcher, matched by preflight and other multi-verb families already in the tree.
notes: The verb is core, not grouped, because it spans discover-to-audit and is invoked from harness hooks; OLD_FLAT_MAP is untouched (no legacy form existed). Design section 9 decision: no MCP tool for feedback in v1 (rejected: an rcf_feedback_add MCP tool, adds a second code path to test before the first has users; add when an MCP-only harness appears).
